measurement_note: Size is n, the array length governing the required O(n^3) construction of n small-alphabet samples. Every tier uses the maximum legal interval [1, 10^9], so interpolation is required after all samples are built. The accepted prefix/suffix DP and an independent same-class formulation take O(n^3) time. A correct control that scans all predecessor ranks for every DP transition takes O(n^4), completes all 16/32/64-length tiers, and is rejected only by scaling.
